headline: Agenda to unlock European investments proposed by Sanz Lovatón
summary: Industry and Commerce Minister Eduardo Sanz Lovatón proposed meeting European Union embassies to identify obstacles to pending investment projects. He said permits, authorisations or financing gaps would be addressed case by case.
why: Delays in permits and financing can hold back foreign direct investment, which matters for investors assessing the Dominican business environment.
original_headline: Agenda para destrabar inversiones europeas propuesta por Sanz Lovatón
